Here are three concise bullet points summarizing the key attendance and grading dispute policy for an introductory computer science course:  • **Attendance Policy**: Regular attendance and active participation in class are expected. More than two unexcused absences will negatively impact participation grades. Students are expected to make up any missed work within a reasonable timeframe.  • **Grading Dispute Policy**: If a student disputes a grade, they must submit a written request to the instructor within 3 business days of receiving the grade. The student must provide specific reasons for the dispute and provide evidence to support their claim. The instructor will review the request and respond with a revised grade or explanation.  • **Academic Integrity Policy**: Plagiarism, cheating, and other forms of academic dishonesty will not be tolerated. Any instances of academic dishonesty will result in a zero on the assignment and may lead to further disciplinary action, including failure in the course.
